title: Payment outage runbook
content: For payment DOWN, check dependency connectivity and record the verified outage as SEV1. Include observed status and latency in the incident draft. Obtain user approval before creating any incident.

title: Payment degradation guide
content: For this mock scenario, payment DEGRADED with sustained latency is SEV2. Query current status, describe the evidence and propose an incident for user approval.

title: Authentication health guide
content: A HEALTHY auth service requires a status report. An incident is unnecessary unless additional evidence indicates a failure.

title: Incident severity reference
content: SEV1: service outage. SEV2: significant degradation in the configured scenario. SEV3: limited impact. SEV4: informational. Apply the relevant service runbook and include evidence; user approval authorizes the exact draft.
